# caveman

Answer in a compressed caveman register that drops filler and keeps every technical fact, for the rest of the session. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

Ships in the [`caveman`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install caveman@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add caveman@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install caveman@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
